content:
maya: quick thread on invoke card narration + copy flows. QA noticed inconsistent VoiceOver announcements when users press the copy button in expanded tool outputs. Some recordings show the SR reading the raw JSON instead of a friendly summary.

sam: that's a known risk. we should separate what we copy from what we expose to AT by default. proposal: Copy button copies a sanitized summary string, and we add a secondary "Copy raw JSON" in a menu for power users.

jon: agree. SRs should announce the result summary only. what should the summary include? my take: schema name, status, and one or two key fields (e.g., Total, Status). keep it under ~120 chars.

lisa: accessibility nit: the copy action must announce success via a polite live region update like "Summary copied". also ensure focus remains on the copy button after action to avoid context loss.

carlos: perf/impl note: run history is virtualized. we can't put a unique live region in each row. implement a single offscreen live region for the whole list and update it (debounced) on copy.

maya: good pattern. also voiceover sometimes reads punctuation weirdly. format the summary as natural language: e.g., "InvoiceSummary — total one thousand two hundred thirty-four dollars — parsed successfully". avoid raw keys and braces.

sam: for multi-tool chains, include source attribution briefly: "via StripeParser". keep it after the main summary. e.g., "InvoiceSummary — Total $1,234 — parsed successfully, via StripeParser".

jon: UI copy: primary button label should be "Copy summary" and the menu item "Copy raw JSON". button needs aria-describedby linking to a short explanation: "Copies a cleaned, human-readable summary."

lisa: for keyboard users, ensure the menu is reachable and menu items have role="menuitem" and appropriate aria-labels. when raw JSON is copied, announce "Raw JSON copied" so users know what was copied.

carlos: about the sanitized summary generation: backend can return a display_summary field when tool authors provide one. fallback to a small generator that pulls allowed keys via a schema whitelist. avoid client-side heavy parsing for performance.

maya: designers: how should the copy affordance render in compact rows vs expanded?

sam: compact rows get a single inline copy icon (clipboard) that copies the summary. expanded panel shows explicit "Copy summary" and a kebab menu with "Copy raw JSON". compact copy should have an accessible label like "Copy summary for InvoiceSummary".

lisa: when compact copy is used, SR should say "Summary copied for InvoiceSummary". for long schema names, truncate visually but don't truncate in the spoken string; use aria-label with full name.

jon: edge case: if the summary contains sensitive tokens (PII), we must block copying by default and surface a confirmation dialog: "Summary may contain sensitive data. Copy anyway?" with yes/no. dialog should be role="alertdialog" and trap focus.

maya: good call. also add a visual badge on the card: "May contain sensitive data" with title text. that helps users avoid accidental copies.

sam: small copy tweak: use sentence-case labels. "Copy summary" not "Copy Summary". keep microcopy consistent across the Console.

carlos: implementation tasks: add display_summary to tool output proto, expose a copy endpoints for sanitized copy, and single live region update. i'll spike it and post an implementation note.

lisa: test plan: NVDA + VoiceOver tests for copy actions, menu navigation, dialog trap, and live region messages. also test fast repeated copies (debounce announcements to avoid SR spam).

maya: action items:
- carlos: spike backend + client copy endpoints with live region pattern (eta Tue)
- sam: update mocks and compact/expanded copy affordances (eta Mon)
- lisa: write a11y test cases and narration strings (eta Tue)
- jon: add UX copy variants and oversight for sensitive-data flows (eta Tue)

design-bot: branch "invoke-copy-flow-summaries" created from maya/design. preview will deploy after commits.

maya: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short doc and a couple of sample SR narration clips. :thumbsup:
